headline: Whirlpool of India appoints former Vanguard executive to board
hook: New leadership oversight at Whirlpool India
summary: Whirlpool of India has appointed former Vanguard executive Sangeeta Pendurkar as an independent director on its board. The appointment is effective immediately for a five-year term. Pendurkar brings extensive experience from the financial services and consumer goods sectors. This change strengthens the company's corporate governance structure as it navigates the competitive Indian appliance market.
why_it_matters: Board changes signal long-term governance shifts for shareholders.
